create_ContextSize: create a ContextSize instance with type and value for trigger or keep parameters
create_SummarizationConfig: create a SummarizationConfig with enabled, trigger, keep, and summary_prompt settings
get_summarization_config: get the current global summarization configuration instance
set_summarization_config: set the global summarization configuration to a new SummarizationConfig instance
load_summarization_config_from_dict: load summarization configuration from a dictionary of settings
